sections.history: Therazhundur lies about 15 km from Mayiladuthurai, in Mayiladuthurai district (some listings Nagapattinam). It is a Paadal Petra Sthalam, hymned in the Tevaram by Tirugnana Sambandar. Two inscriptions in 12th-century script, of the 34th and 44th years of Kulottunga Chola I, are found here; the temple is medieval and later Chola.
sections.architecture: A Dravidian delta temple, the shrine enshrines Vedapureeswarar in the sanctum, with the goddess Soundaraambigai in her own shrine, a Nandi and the parivara devatas about the prakara. The walled courtyard and gopuram keep the form of the Shiva temples near Mayiladuthurai. (The town also holds the Vishnu temple of Amaruviappan, a Divya Desam.)
sections.legends: Tradition tells that the child-saint Sambandar could not tell this Shiva temple apart from the neighbouring Vishnu shrine, and Ganesha manifested to point out the shrine of Shiva. Shiva is worshipped as Vedapureeswarar, 'lord of the city of the Vedas,' with Soundaraambigai beside him; the shrine is a prarthana sthalam for those seeking marriage or the reunion of estranged couples.
sections.festivals: The temple observes Maha Shivaratri in Masi (February–March), Navaratri in Purattasi (September–October) and the Mondays of Karthikai, with Pradosha worship. Devotees come to Vedapureeswarar to pray for marriage and household harmony.
sections.experience: At Therazhundur the pilgrim comes to the lord of the Vedas' city. Before Vedapureeswarar and Soundaraambigai, in the green country near Mayiladuthurai, the visitor finds the quiet grace of a Tevaram temple, and the memory of Ganesha who pointed the way for the child-saint.

visit.timings: Typically open from early morning to midday and again from late afternoon into the evening; confirm timings locally, especially on festival days.
visit.dressCode: Modest traditional attire is expected, with shoulders and knees covered; footwear is left at the entrance.
visit.photography: Photography is generally allowed in the outer corridors but not inside the sanctum; ask temple staff before photographing rituals.
visit.gettingThere: Therazhundur lies about 15 km from Mayiladuthurai, in Mayiladuthurai district. Mayiladuthurai is the nearest town and rail head, with buses and taxis to the village.
